places.quote: I presently departed from the Commons, feeling very young when I went out of Spenlow and Jorkins’s
places.note: Narrator refers to Doctors' Commons as 'the Commons'; the courtyard of the Doctors is where he was taken.

places.quote: We arrived at Lincoln’s Inn Fields without any new adventures
There is a furnished little set of chambers to be let in the Adelphi, Trot
in Buckingham Street in the Adelphi there was to be let furnished, with a view of the river
I saw her safely seated in the Dover coach
places.note: Destination of the coach, not visited in passage.

places.quote: and, sure enough, the river was outside the windows
places.note: Not named in text; identified as Thames from Adelphi chambers.
